name: RadioGroup
description: Radix RadioGroup with roving focus. The group owns the value; items are stateless.
intent: Exactly one choice from a small set, with every option visible.

authority.note: src/ is authoritative. If this contract disagrees with the source, implement from the source and report the drift.

props.name: className
props.hint: Merged with the component classes via cn(). Use for layout only — never to override a variant that already exists.

keyboard: Arrow keys — move between and select options
Tab — enter and leave the group as one stop
requiredAttributes: A label for the group itself, via aria-label or aria-labelledby
notes: The whole group is one tab stop. Arrow keys move within it. This is correct and expected — do not add tabIndex to items.
Arrow-key navigation selects as it moves. If that is wrong for your case, the control should be a ui:select.

agentRules: Label the group, not only the items.
Every RadioGroupItem needs a Label with htmlFor.
Provide a default value unless empty is genuinely valid.

relatedComponents.note: Compact exclusive choice in a toolbar
